correctness.rationale: For a scalar affine contraction |a|<1 with c=1−a>0 and fixed distinct trials d=x1−x0≠0, verified algebraically that unsafeguarded depth-one Anderson Z−θ=m+dN/D where m=(x0+x1)/2−θ, N=cm−(ε0+ε1)/2 and D=−cd+ε1−ε0. Equal marginal Gaussian variances imply Cov(N,D)=0 and independence even at rho=±1, so N~N(cm,σ²(1+rho)/2), D~N(−cd,2σ²(1−rho)). If rho<1, D has positive density at 0, and conditioning on N gives tP(|Z−θ|>t)→2|d|f_D(0)E|N| by dominated convergence; the shift m changes no leading coefficient. The 1/t tail gives finite positive moments iff q<1 whenever N is not a.s. zero. Exceptional rho=1 gives Z−θ=ε/c normal, rho=−1 & m=0 gives exact Z=θ. Differentiating log K for m=0 has a unique critical rho*=(1−b)/(1+b) and maximum 2σ/(πc) exp(−(1+b)/2). Independently verified 250 exact rational substitutions and six b-values against a 2000-correlation grid. The trial points must be prescribed, not adapted; center about unknown θ only hypothetical.
